title: Baunilha Shader
description: A lightweight vanilla-focused shader that adds shadows and depth for the most classic Minecraft experience possible.
body:
![Main](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38dbdc5923150f466c431264938261bd6feb9fa9.jpeg)
🍃 Baunilha Shaders

Welcome to **Baunilha Shaders**, a lightweight and vanilla-focused shader pack designed to enhance your Minecraft world without losing its iconic, classic charm. If you want to elevate your game's atmosphere while keeping the true performance and look of the original game, this is the project for you!

---

## ✨ Features
* **Accurate Shadows:** Enjoy clean, dynamic shadows that bring depth to every block.
* **Sun-Tracked Lighting:** Real-time lighting that naturally follows the sun and moon cycles.
* **Vanilla Spirit:** Enhanced visuals that strictly respect the original aesthetic and color palette of Minecraft.
* **Performance Friendly:** Built with simplicity in mind, making it perfect for everyday survival gameplay.

## 🛠️ Requirements & Compatibility
* Designed to work smoothly with the **Iris** shader loader.
* Works great on both low-end and high-end machines due to its rustic and optimized nature.

---

## 🗺️ Roadmap & Future Updates
This is my very first shader project, and it is continuously improving! Here is what I am currently working on for future releases:
* [ ] Custom water reflections and transparency
* [ ] Colored light support
* [ ] Motion blur adjustments
* [ ] Subtle bloom effects
* [ ] Technical bug fixes and optimization
* [ ] Sky
Thank you for downloading and supporting my work! Feel free to leave feedback or report issues in the comments.**
